ops.text: Use pnpm, not npm, in this repository. Never run npm install here, and delete package-lock.json if it exists.
Store all monetary amounts as integer cents, never floats. Convert with toCents() and format with formatCents() from src/lib/money.ts.
Do not add new UI libraries; use the project's own components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button) instead.
Set `draft: true` in the frontmatter of every new post until the project owner has reviewed it.
Store post images in `public/images/<post-slug>/` and save them as `.webp` files.
Place unit test files next to the source file they test, not in a __tests__ folder, e.g. src/domain/budget.test.ts.
Never hand-edit files in src/api/generated; add new endpoints to openapi.yaml and regenerate them with `pnpm gen:api`.
Use npm, not pnpm, for installing and managing packages in this project. Keep package-lock.json and do not create pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep business logic out of components: put calculations in src/domain and expose them to components through a hook in src/hooks.
Store dates in UTC and route all date display and comparisons through src/lib/dates.ts, which uses date-fns-tz with the user's timezone. Never compare dates using local-time new Date() values.
Default the app's currency to GBP, since this is a UK product.
Write all UI copy in British English spelling, e.g. 'colour', 'categorise', 'organisation'.
Never use emojis in post content, including headings. Keep headings plain text.
Always run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` before reporting a task as done in this repository, because CI fails on lint errors otherwise.
Never run git commit or git push in this repository. Leave all changes uncommitted so the project owner can review the diff.
Never use toFixed or multiply-by-100 arithmetic on monetary amounts; use toCents and formatCents from src/lib/money.ts, keeping money as integer cents end to end.
Never use window.confirm for confirmations in this project; use the Dialog component from src/ui instead.
Use bun only in this repository: run `bun install` and `bun run <script>`. pnpm is no longer used.
Commit each finished task separately in this repository using a conventional commit message (feat:, fix:, etc.); never run git push. This replaces the earlier leave-uncommitted rule.
Run API client generation with `bun run gen:api` in this repository; pnpm no longer exists, so `pnpm gen:api` is obsolete.
